assetStyle.purpose: Unified visual specification for AI-generated BattleNess inventory and summon assets.
assetStyle.generalStyle: Dark high-fantasy action-RPG game assets rendered as premium 3D concept art. Each image contains one isolated object or one complete creature, centered and fully visible. The silhouette must remain readable at small inventory-icon size while retaining rich material detail at full resolution.

rendering.quality: AAA game asset, highly detailed, physically believable materials
rendering.technique: 3D concept render with realistic material response and controlled painterly finishing
rendering.lighting: cinematic studio lighting, strong rim light, focused internal elemental illumination
rendering.contrast: high contrast with clear separation between subject and transparent background
rendering.sharpness: crisp focal subject, clean edges, no motion blur obscuring the silhouette
rendering.background: transparent alpha; a black preview background may be used only for review, never baked into the final asset
rendering.shadow: subtle contact or internal shadow only when needed; no floor or environment
rendering.resolution: generate at the highest practical square resolution, ideally 1536x1536 or larger, then downsample
rendering.orientation: three-quarter view with slight variation between assets
rendering.safeMargin: keep at least 6 percent transparent space around the complete subject

fire.recognition: Immediately recognizable by ember red and molten orange light.
fire.materials: obsidian, blackened iron, basalt, copper, molten glass and magma fissures.
fire.effects: flames, embers, sparks, smoke and heat distortion; effects remain controlled around the silhouette.

electric.recognition: Immediately recognizable by electric yellow and white-gold energy, with limited blue accents.
electric.materials: conductive gold, copper coils, dark gunmetal, brass, ceramic and stormglass.
electric.effects: branching lightning, plasma filaments, corona glow and charged particles; emphasize speed and precision.

ice.recognition: Immediately recognizable by pale cyan, sapphire blue, frost white and cold silver.
ice.materials: clear ice, blue crystal, frosted silver, glacial stone and cold dark steel.
ice.effects: frost mist, snow motes, frozen runes and crystalline growth; emphasize weight and stillness.

rarityLanguage.common: Simple practical construction, one focal detail, modest effects, visible wear, clean silhouette.
rarityLanguage.refined: Improved craftsmanship, layered materials, engravings, secondary accents and moderate controlled effects.
rarityLanguage.rare: Named-relic character, unusual asymmetry or ceremonial architecture, complex runes and strong supernatural behavior.
rarityLanguage.epic: Iconic legendary silhouette, regal or monumental craftsmanship, multiple material layers and spectacular controlled energy.

categoryRules.rings: Every ring must be a wearable ring with a clearly visible opening and band. Vary band width, profile, setting, construction method, gemstone placement and asymmetry. Do not turn all rings into crowns.
categoryRules.gems: Vary crystal geometry: shard, pearl, prism, cabochon, cluster, orb, lattice, eye, heart, tear or mineral specimen. Each gem must have a distinct internal structure or inclusion. Avoid repeating the same diamond cut.
categoryRules.monsters: Show the complete creature and make its species readable before its elemental effect. Vary anatomy, body mass, stance, number of limbs, armor placement and focal feature. Elemental effects must support rather than replace the creature design.
categoryRules.spells: Show one isolated magical phenomenon without a caster, hand, weapon, environment or card frame. Give every spell a compact readable silhouette, a distinct motion language and a structural focal point rather than an amorphous cloud of particles.
categoryRules.materials: Show one physically believable crafting specimen or one unified sealed vessel when containment is necessary. Preserve recognizable real-world color, phase and texture while using rarity-appropriate fantasy preparation. Never add chemical symbols, labels or periodic-table text.

consistencyRules: No text, logo, watermark, card frame, socket, UI element or atlas border.
Effects must never obscure the defining silhouette.
Element color must be identifiable at first glance.
Rarity must be identifiable through complexity and craftsmanship rather than merely increasing glow.
Avoid excessive sparkles and tiny visual noise.
Maintain consistent perspective, lighting quality and rendering fidelity across the full collection.
assetStyle.defaultNegativePrompt: text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI frame, card border, atlas grid, multiple subjects, duplicate object, cropped subject, cut-off limbs, cut-off ring, scenery, landscape, opaque background, flat cartoon, pixel art, muddy materials, excessive bloom, excessive particles, glitter noise, unreadable silhouette

fire.profile: Highest direct damage, higher cooldowns and meaningful penalties, lower-to-moderate survivability.

electric.profile: Lowest energy requirements, highest speed, lower individual damage, rapid cadence.

ice.profile: Highest monster health, lowest cooldowns, higher energy requirements, lower speed.

designRules.rarityPrinciple: Rarity provides stronger specialization and efficiency rather than a uniform increase to every statistic.
designRules.speedPrinciple: Speed is a power budget component because total equipped speed influences which player starts.
